_comment: Curated supplemental data for Croatian mountain huts (HPS). Matched against OSM-derived hut POIs by name (case- and diacritic-insensitive) and lat/lng proximity (within 500 m). Fields here are MERGED into the matched POI: HPS data wins for `phone`, `capacity`, `season`, `note_en`, `note_hr`, `url`. Edit this file by hand to add or correct entries; the next `npm run enrich-pois` run picks them up. Sources: hps.hr hut directory and planinarski-portal.org GIS profiles.
_format: Array of entries with { name, lat, lng, phone?, capacity?, season?, url?, note_en?, note_hr? }
